headquarters: Mantralaya, Vallabh Bhawan, Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh - 462004
description: The nodal agency tasked with overseeing primary, secondary, and higher secondary education, formulating academic policies, and implementing free education schemes across MP.
sub_divisions: State Council of Educational Research and Training (SCERT MP)
Madhya Pradesh Board of Secondary Education (MPBSE)
primary_functions: Operation and regulation of government primary, middle, and high schools
Implementation of Right to Education (RTE) Act and free admission drive in private schools
Conducting Board examinations for Class 10th and 12th through MPBSE
Teacher recruitment, training, and school infrastructure development
key_services_offered: Online RTE lottery application for 25% quota in private schools
Distribution of free textbooks, uniforms, and cycles under state student welfare schemes
Publication of MPBSE board results and mark sheet verifications
School recognition, affiliation, and teacher transfer portal operations
